SYNTHETIC STDERR (Phase 5 plan 01, explicitly blocked) — not captured from a real gemini-cli run.

Blocker: gemini-cli 0.37.1 auth isolation ineffective on the capture host.
  - isolateOAuth (temp GEMINI_CONFIG_DIR) + GEMINI_API_KEY=invalid-key-12345 still yielded
    exit=0 with a successful "Hello" response, indicating an uncovered cached-credential path.
  - No GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS set, no ~/.config/gcloud, no ~/AppData/*/gcloud present.

A real auth failure would produce stderr output similar to:

  Error: API key not valid. Please pass a valid API key. [HTTP 401]
  Status: UNAUTHENTICATED

Real-capture hardening deferred to a follow-up gap-closure phase
(resolution_phase: follow-up-auth-isolation-hardening).
